input.question: Who is the husband of Chilonis?

documents.text: Chilonis (daughter of Leotychidas) Chilonis () was a Spartan princess, daughter of Leotychidas, wife of Acrotatus and mother of Areus II. She is known from Plutarch's "Life of Pyrrhus". Her much older husband Acrotatus, a son of the king Areus I, had not been allowed to succeed to his father's throne because of his violent and tyrannical behaviour, and had spent many years away from Sparta as a soldier of fortune.
